intent: Publish WonRemote v0.1.79 with automatic startup device loading, a compact Android Viewer, concurrent remote sessions, verified PC and Android downloads, and reliable hosted-UI refresh for installed Android Viewers.

requestReview.reason: Authentication owns one bounded startup device/status refresh. Sessions open only from explicit Connect actions, with no polling or automatic reconnect. Android launch revalidates one Hosting document but adds no Firestore operation.
requestReview.assumptions: Scoped example, not fleet billing: one Viewer authenticates once and explicitly opens two Agents once in a day. The budget covers startup device/status refresh plus two session creations, start commands, signaling documents, Viewer ICE candidates, listener delivery, and dependent rule reads. Idle time, rerenders, tab switching, returning to the list, and Hosting document revalidation add zero Firestore operations. WebRTC media and TURN bytes remain separate.

checks.idle: Real Chromium fake time proves one startup list request, zero history reads, zero subscriptions, and no additional Firestore request over 24 hours.
checks.rerender: Repeated auth callbacks and session switching reuse existing request and session owners without another list read, session open, or transport start.
checks.concurrency: Pending/open per-device guards coalesce duplicate Connect actions; the tested two-session path opens two distinct explicitly selected devices once each.
checks.failure: Quota/list and WebRTC failures retain manual retry and cannot start an automatic retry loop; Hosting revalidation retains the existing WebView error boundary.
checks.cleanup: Logout rejects stale list results; closing one session releases its input and transport without closing the other session.

rollback: Repoint stable PC downloads to v0.1.78, restore the prior Android ZIPs and Hosting version, then revert the v0.1.79 feature and follow-up fix commits without changing registered device data.

outcomes.acceptance: After restored Firebase authentication or successful local login, the Viewer loads registered devices exactly once without a manual click; repeated callbacks, rerenders, and 24-hour idle add no request.
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-05: `npx vitest run src/viewerDeviceRefresh.test.ts` passed 9/9 in real Chromium, including one startup request, repeated auth callbacks, 24-hour idle, manual history/reconnect, logout cancellation, and reauthentication.
outcomes.physicalGap: Installed desktop and Android launch behavior and live Firebase billing remain physical checks.

outcomes.acceptance: Android portrait and landscape layouts have no horizontal overflow, keep primary controls reachable, and allow two remote sessions to remain connected, switch by named tabs, and close independently with input limited to the selected session.
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-05: The focused Chromium case failed before the fix because the command bar was 749px above the bottom of a 390x844 viewport, then passed. The full file passed 9/9 and proves portrait/landscape layout, two transports opened once, tab switching, isolated close, and active-session input ownership.
outcomes.physicalGap: Physical Android WebView keyboard, touch, rotation, concurrent Agents, and WebRTC/TURN resource use require device verification.
